claims.content: The use case is triggered when a new customer decides to register on the Website by creating an account. This occurs when the customer clicks the 'Register Now' link in the top navigation bar, accesses the registration page, and begins entering required information to create a FREE membership account.

After the registration process is completed (either via short or full registration), the system displays a 'Welcome Back!' message and presents the Sign In page with fields for Member ID/Email and Password; the My Account link is accessible in the navigation bar.

In the full-registration alternative flow, when the customer completes Registration Page 2 via the 'Finish Now' button, the system completes the full registration process and saves all provided optional information (billing/shipping addresses, shipping preferences) to the customer's account profile.

Upon successful registration, the system triggers an automated transactional email containing a Thank You message and instructions to enable cookies and add the appropriate email address(es) to the whitelist or Safe Senders list.

Upon successful completion of the full-registration path via the 'Save Changes' button, the system displays a pop-up message instructing the user to add shop@jewelryTV.rsys1.com to their address book or Safe Senders list and to enable cookies in their browser.

If the short registration is completed via the 'I Want to Sign in Now!' button, the system takes the user to the sign-in page; if they were previously browsing prior to registering, it returns them to their last product details page, or if they were on the home page, it returns them to the home page.
A new customer wants to create a free JTVauctions.com membership account.

scope_contract.goal_statement: A new customer wants to create a free JTVauctions.com membership account.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: A new customer creates a free JTVauctions.com membership account.
scope_contract.start_boundary: The customer begins the registration process to create a new JTVauctions.com account.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The customer has successfully created a free JTVauctions.com membership account.
in_scope_actions: Registering for a free membership account
excluded_adjacent_actions: Signing in to the newly created account
Accessing preferred payment type after registration
variant_dimensions: Selectable registration options are handled as alternative flows; the goal itself is the same across variants

claims.content: At main_flow step 1, if the customer's browser has cookies disabled, the site requires cookies to be enabled to function correctly. The system does not auto-correct this; the customer must manually enable cookies (or restore default settings). Exit: registration cannot proceed until cookies are enabled.

At main_flow step 4, if the customer attempts to submit the registration form without checking the Terms of Use checkbox, the system blocks submission: the 'I Want to Sign in Now!' button is grayed out until the checkbox is checked; if the user clicks the grayed-out 'Finish Now' button, a popup appears stating that they must read and agree to the Terms of Use before they can proceed. Exit: the attempted submission is blocked.

At main_flow step 4, if the customer does not agree to be bound by the Terms of Use Agreement, they cannot access or use the Website or submit an order or bid on the Website. Exit: the registrant is not permitted to use the Website.
At main_flow step 5, if the Member ID ('Handle') is not unique in the database customer table, registration cannot proceed.
At main_flow step 5, if the Email Address is not unique in the customer table, the system notifies the registrant that the email address is already in use. Exit: registration cannot proceed.

At the duplicate-email exception branch (main_flow step 5), the system asks the registrant if they need to reset the password for the existing account; if the registrant indicates 'yes', the system generates an email with a temporary password. Exit: password recovery is initiated via the emailed temporary password.
At main_flow step 5, if the Password is outside the required 8-to-12 character range, the input is invalid and registration cannot proceed.

At main_flow step 5, if the Consumer Protection negative file is cross-referenced and a match is found, the system displays: 'We are sorry, we are unable to create an auction account for you at this time. If you believe this message to be in error, please contact our Customer Service team at: 800-550-8393.' Exit: account creation is refused.

At main_flow step 5, if the registrant is not age 18 or over and is not age 13–18 using the Website with a parent/guardian's permission, they are outside the permitted categories; use of the Website is restricted to those categories, and by using the Website the registrant represents that they are in one of these categories. Exit: the ineligible registrant is not permitted to use the Website.

Diverges from Step 6: after completing the short registration form on Page 1, instead of clicking 'I Want to Sign in Now!' to finish, the customer chooses to proceed to Registration Page 2. On this page, they may provide additional information such as billing/shipping addresses and shipping preferences.

Continuing the alternative that diverges from Step 5: on Registration Page 2, after providing additional shipping and billing information, the customer clicks 'Finish Now'. The system completes the full registration with the provided billing/shipping addresses and shipping preferences saved to the customer's account profile.
The customer enters their First Name and Last Name into the designated text fields on Registration Page 1.
The customer provides and verifies an Email Address (entered twice) and creates a unique Member ID ('Handle').
The customer creates a password of 8 to 12 characters and verifies it by re-entering it.
The customer selects a payment method from the available options (PayPal, Amazon Payments, or Credit Card).
The customer checks the box to accept and agree to the Terms of Use.
The customer clicks the 'I Want to Sign in Now!' button to complete the short registration process immediately without providing additional optional information.

Upon successful completion of the short registration process, the system triggers an automated transactional email with a Thank You message, instructing the customer to enable cookies and add the appropriate email address(es) to their whitelist or Safe Senders list.
The user is accessing the JTVauctions.com website.
The customer has access to a valid email address and a valid phone number for account creation.
The customer is a new customer who does not already have a registered JTVauctions.com account.

quality_flags.detail: [exceptionflow_exit_coverage] Exception flow claim 9 (age restriction) states an eligibility rule and representation but lacks a clear branch outcome. It does not say that registration is refused/blocked for age-ineligible users, nor provide a return/handoff. The branch therefore has no explicit terminal failure/prevention state. (still no supporting evidence after retrieval)

[mainflow_postconditions_reachability] The main_flow only describes the short-registration path, ending with the customer clicking 'I Want to Sign in Now!' and never reaching Registration Page 2 or the 'Finish Now'/'Save Changes' controls. The postcondition claims at 0-based indices 1 and 3 describe full-registration alternative-flow outcomes, so they are not reachable from the main flow. (atomic grounding: candidate remains incomplete (Explicit evidence is not cited for the added detail that the Page 1 registration consists of 'required fields' or that proceeding to Registration Page 2 is specifically 'instead of clicking I Want to Sign in Now!'.))

[mainflow_postconditions_reachability] The main flow follows the short-registration path and ends with the customer clicking 'I Want to Sign in Now!' and the system sending the thank-you email. It never includes the full-registration alternative flow, so the full-registration-only postconditions (Finish Now saving optional information and the Save Changes pop-up) are not reachable from the main flow.

[altflow_diverge_points] Alternative flow claim 2 (0-based index 1) says it is continuing an alternative that 'diverges from Step 5', but the actual divergence point for this alternative is Step 6, where the customer chooses not to click 'I Want to Sign in Now!' and instead proceeds to Registration Page 2. Step 5 exists in main_flow, but it is the Terms-of-Use acceptance step and is logically unrelated to the shipping/billing continuation. The cited divergence point is therefore invalid.

inconsistency_hints: The trigger can only be initiated by a 'new customer', meaning the customer must not already have a JTVauctions account, but the preconditions do not include this state. Without an explicit unregistered/no-account precondition, the trigger's role restriction is not covered upstream.

Exception flow claim 1 (cookies disabled) does not specify a clear branch outcome. It says the site needs cookies enabled and the user must manually enable them, but does not state whether registration is blocked/terminated until cookies are enabled, returns to main_flow step 1, or hands off. This leaves the exception without an explicit terminal failure/prevention state or continuation.

The main_flow is explicitly the short-registration path: step 6 uses the 'I Want to Sign in Now!' button and step 7 describes completion of the short registration process. No main-flow step performs a full registration via 'Finish Now' or saves optional billing/shipping addresses and shipping preferences, so the full-registration postcondition cannot be reached.

The main_flow never includes a 'Save Changes' action; the only completion path is 'I Want to Sign in Now!' for the short registration. Therefore the postcondition describing a pop-up after 'Save Changes' is unreachable from the main_flow.

Alternative flow claim 1 says 'Diverges from Step 5', but the branch it describes is 'instead of clicking I Want to Sign in Now!' — that is main_flow step 6, not step 5 (the Terms checkbox). Step 5 is therefore not the actual divergence point for this alternative.

Exception flow claim 9 states only an age restriction / representation ('Website is restricted... registrant represents...') and does not define a branch condition or an explicit outcome. It neither returns to a main_flow step, terminates/hands off, nor documents a terminal failure/prevention state for ineligible registrants.
